question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Extirpate**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Establish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Extirpate"** means to completely destroy or eradicate something, often referring to removing it from its roots. (जड़ से उखाड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **Efforts were made to extirpate invasive species from the ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **"Establish" **is the opposite of extirpate as it refers to creating or setting up something permanently or firmly. (स्थापित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The company plans to establish a new office in the city.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **"Extirpate"** is **"Establish"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Establish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exterminate **(समाप्त करना): To destroy completely, often used in the context of killing pests or enemies.
 
 
• **Example:** The government launched a campaign to exterminate mosquitoes carrying the disease.
 
 
 
• **Uproot **(जड़ से उखाड़ना): To pull out by the roots or completely remove something from its place.
 
 
• **Example: **The farmer uprooted the weeds from the field.
 
 
 
• **Eradicate** (समूल नष्ट करना): To destroy or eliminate completely.
 
 
• **Example:** Scientists are working to eradicate diseases from the world.

The correct answer is **option 2.**
